Every `.tf` file here that opens with

    # Code generated by Headroom. DO NOT EDIT.

is written by Headroom, and Headroom will **delete** it on a run that no
longer places a policy on that target. Edits do not survive; make them in
`../modules/scps/` or in a file of your own.

This README is not marked, and neither is anything else you add. Unmarked
files, non-`.tf` files, and symlinks are never touched - a hand-written
`custom_scps.tf` beside the generated ones is safe.

Deleting a file here is the point rather than a side effect: Terraform loads
the whole directory, so a policy file left behind after its placement
disappeared keeps deploying a decision Headroom no longer makes.
